title: Normative Modals: jogosult and köteles ('entitled to / obligated to + infinitive')

sections.title: Legal Modality Beyond kell and lehet
sections.content: In high-register normative Hungarian, colloquial modals like kell, lehet, or muszáj are replaced by the predicate adjectives jogosult (entitled / authorized to) and köteles (obligated / duty-bound to). Both govern infinitive verbal complements: 'Az állampolgár jogosult pert indítani' (The citizen is entitled to file a lawsuit).

sections.title: Subject Agreement and Plural Inflection
sections.content: Unlike invariant modal auxiliaries, jogosult and köteles agree with their subject in number: plural subjects require plural forms jogosultak and kötelesek ('A képviselők kötelesek megjelenni'). In past and conditional tenses, they take the appropriate copula: jogosult volt, köteles lett volna.

sections.title: Entitlement vs. Obligation with Infinitive
rows: Minden választópolgár jogosult szavazni a parlamenti választásokon.
Every eligible voter is entitled to vote in parliamentary elections.
A köztársasági elnök köteles aláírni a törvényt a megadott határidőn belül.
The President of the Republic is obligated to sign the law within the deadline.
A vádlottak nem kötelesek önmaguk ellen vallomást tenni.
Defendants are not obligated to testify against themselves.
A hatóságok jogosultak ellenőrizni a jogszabályok betartását.
The authorities are entitled to verify compliance with statutes.

items.spanish: A polgárok jogosultak békésen gyülekezni és véleményüket szabadon kinyilvánítani.
items.english: Citizens are entitled to assemble peacefully and to express their opinions freely.

items.spanish: A kormány köteles beszámolni a parlamentnek éves gazdálkodásáról.
items.english: The government is duty-bound to account to parliament for its annual economic management.

items.spanish: A bíróság köteles indokolni minden érdemi határozatát.
items.english: The court is obligated to justify every substantive decision.

sections.title: B2 Usage Notice
sections.content: Remember subject agreement in the plural: 'Az állampolgárok jogosultak kérvényt benyújtani' (never *jogosult!).
